---
applyTo: '**'
---
- When summarizing codes, please organize the code. For classes, please list the attributes and methods. For attributes, please explain what they do. For methods, please explain what they do and how they work.
- Use snippets to illustrate your points.
- When summarizing code files, please provide a high-level overview of the file's purpose and functionality before diving into specific classes or functions.
- When explaining code snippets, please provide context on how they fit into the larger codebase or application.
- Use clear and concise language to ensure the summary is easily understandable.
- Structure the summary with headings and subheadings for better readability.
